newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond activity quickens, surge of FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond activity quickens, surge of FRNs.

text.p: ** Activity in the primary market picked up on Wednesday,
with the FRN sector particularly busy.
** GMAC launched a $1.0 billion five-year FRN.
** An AMEX unit issued a $400 million five-year FRN.
** Korea Development Bank launched a 500 million mark FRN.
** In the pipeline is a mark FRN for City of Gothenburg.
Primary market activity picked up on Wednesday, with the focus on FRNs.
Late in the session GMAC issued a $1.0 billion five-year FRN, and previously AMEX had launched a $400 million FRN at the same maturity.
Dealers said there had been a borrowing window in that sector due to the recent shortage of supply.
"There is still a lot of fixed-rate paper around, so no new deals can be absorbed," a syndicate manager at a U.S. bank said.
"There was an opening on the floater side, but that has now been filled too," he said.
Still in the pipeline was a possible 300 million mark FRN for City of Gothenburg, dealers said, but otherwise the market was expected to remain subdued this week.
Talk was circulating on Wednesday about Russia's dollar bond, the mandate for which was announced on Tuesday.
Dealers said although Russia was likely to want to issue a seven- or ten-year deal, market conditions would make it hard to issue beyond five years.
The timing of the deal was also unclear, with the next transaction out of Russia expected to be Moscow's debut bond.
Two teams of Moscow officials are expected to visit European, Asian and U.S. investors starting in the middle of May and launch of the deal could come during the last week.
A $500 million five-year bond is expected via CSFB and Nomura.
